turns.teacher: Good morning children. Sit properly, bags under the desk. Today we are doing subtraction.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: First sum on the board. Fifty two minus twenty seven. Do it in your notebooks.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Rabi, you wrote thirty five? No, that is wrong. The answer is twenty five. Everybody write twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: I told you yesterday also. When the top number is small, you borrow. You borrow! Listen. When the top is small, you BORROW from the tens.
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Arjoon, thirty five again? Wrong. Sit down, don't do it like that. Next.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Next sum. Sixty three minus twenty eight. Quickly.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Mina, you are counting on fingers again and getting thirty six. It is thirty five. Sixty three minus twenty eight is thirty five. Say it with me.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Who got thirty five? Hands up. Thumbs up if you understood.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Okay, one more. Seventy four minus thirty nine. Finish it at home, I will check tomorrow.
turns.label: new_sum
